changes.comment: Breaking: rename the variables in your `.env`: `SESSION_*` to `MICA_SESSION_*`, `LOGIN_*` to `MICA_SIGNIN_*`, `TRUST_PROXY`, `MAX_UPLOAD_BYTES` and `LOG_LEVEL` to `MICA_` names, and `MICA_ADMIT_GROUP`/`MICA_ADMIT_DOMAIN` to the plural. Every variable is listed at https://micacms.com/docs/configuration/.
